static_endpoints.description: List all available timeseries datasets. Supports pagination via /datasets/timeseries with page and records_per_page params.
static_endpoints.notes: Returns dataset_id, name, metadata fields for each dataset.

static_endpoints.description: Get detailed info about a specific timeseries dataset by its dataset_id.
static_endpoints.notes: Use dataset_id values from the list endpoint.

static_endpoints.description: Maps Energy Aspects website file categories to their corresponding dataset_id values.
static_endpoints.notes: Bridges the website UI to the API. Useful for translating known file downloads to API dataset_ids.

static_endpoints.description: Retrieve timeseries data in JSON format (default).
static_endpoints.parameters: api_key (required), dataset_id, date_from, date_to, release_date, geography, frequency, lifecycle_stage, category, category_detail, aspect, aspect_detail
static_endpoints.notes: Auth via api_key query param. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD or dynamic notation (e.g. -1y, -3Mb). release_date retrieves historic revisions.

static_endpoints.description: Retrieve timeseries data in CSV format.
static_endpoints.parameters: Same as /timeseries, plus column_header (metadata field for CSV column headers)
static_endpoints.notes: Append /csv to the timeseries path for CSV output.

static_endpoints.description: Retrieve timeseries data in Excel format.
Paginated timeseries data retrieval. Also available as /pagination/json and /pagination/csv.
static_endpoints.notes: Non-paginated endpoints return all matching data at once. Use pagination for large result sets.

static_endpoints.description: Dataset changelog showing when datasets were updated. Also available as /changelog/csv, /changelog/xlsx, /changelog/html.
static_endpoints.parameters: api_key (required), date_from (required), date_to (required), dataset_id, page, records_per_page
static_endpoints.notes: date_from and date_to are REQUIRED for changelog endpoints. Pagination available via /changelog/pagination/.

static_endpoints.description: Returns valid parameter values for timeseries filtering (categories, aspects, geographies, frequencies, lifecycle stages).
static_endpoints.notes: Call this first to discover valid filter values before querying /timeseries.
